lines.vo: Just hearing your phone buzz can break your focus, even if you ignore it.
That's not weak willpower. A ping grabs your brain on its own.
Kev tracks his notifications-off hours in his Break the Habit tracker.
In a twenty fifteen Florida State study, people did a focus test while their phones got texts and calls.
lines.cap: In a 2015 Florida State study, people did a focus test while their phones got texts and calls.

lines.vo: They didn't answer, and they didn't check.
But they made more mistakes. The ping alone set their minds wandering.
So mute it, or turn on do not disturb during focus time.
No ping, no detour. That's how you stay on track.

hook: Just *hearing* a ping wrecks your focus
